llm_verdict.message:
The remediation has been successfully applied. The `/home` mount point in `/etc/fstab` now includes the `noexec` option in the fourth column (mount options), changing it from `defaults` to `defaults,noexec`. This prevents binaries in `/home` from being executed, mitigating the vulnerability. Verification via `read_file` confirms the change is present. No further action is required.

{
  "approved": true,
  "approved_feedback": "The noexec mount option has been added to /home in /etc/fstab, which prevents execution of binaries from user home directories, thus mitigating the vulnerability.",
  "approved_plan": "The fix has been applied by updating the /etc/fstab file to include noexec in the mount options for /home. Verification confirms the change is present.",
  "done": true
}
